integrity: The explicit proof is separate from the finite enumerator, which checks 914 integer partitions through order 16 and directly enumerates one-point extension diagrams through order 8; all code and complete output are included.
scientific_limitations: Only nonalgebraic singleton extensions over finite named bases of the homogeneous equivalence-with-classwise-graph structure. A minimality and uniqueness theorem at order 16, not a classification of all larger counterexamples. Historical priority remains contingent on unindexed literature; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp first loss of unimodality in classwise-random one-point type spectra
